cases.prompt: Pick up the object and place it next to the other objects.

scope: Full Generator encode/denoise/decode; phase/branch-aware whole-transformer CUDA Graph for all modes; current inputs copied and outputs owned
policy_input_limit: Robot observation images; bridge_orig_lerobot interface/domain selected, without matched action ground truth. Not a task success benchmark.
ffn: BF16 baseline; budget modes share model-local RTN W0/W1 and choose base, half/full A, full W, or their first-order combination. BF16 attention. W1 remains allocated across tiers.

validation_gate.scope: Selected using these validation seeds; requires independent final evaluation. Passing means within provisional tolerances of the uniform reference, not absolute quality or task success.

budget_policy.scope: Runtime-only export of the archived validation-selected FFN policy. Refit on a new device/model/distribution; original full policy retains calibration units and costs.

budget_scope: Layer/phase/CFG A/W tier allocation; partial A supports use current-input GPU energy ranks; BF16 attention
release_smoke_scope: Two-step portability/integration check only; not trajectory quality or speed evidence. Raw outputs stay local.
